Name: 7B2's SDV Maru Portrait Replacer
Author: NexusUser7B2
Description:
This is just a simple portrait replacer for Maru. Hope you all enjoy it!


Credits:
The history that led to these portraits is a bit complex so I'm just going to list how things happened in order so each person is credited for exactly what they did.
1. ConcernedApe who is the original creator of Maru
2. Me for the original base portrait when it was a front view portrait of Triss from TW3 (made a new more accurate one, had Crywolfe improve it, and repurposed this one to be a Maru portrait)
3. Crywolfe from kofi for taking the commission to greatly improve on what I had done at the time it was still a Triss portrait. ( https://ko-fi.com/crywolfe )
4. Me for making some heavy changes to turn it into a Maru portrait
5. Zender1752 from deviantart for taking the commission to improve on what I did and remaking the vanilla outfits ( https://www.deviantart.com/zender1752 )
6. whitebalverines for improving some things such as the nurse hat and texturing on the outfits ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/45507937 )

For asking permission to make seasonal variants or whatever you only need mine since I commissioned each of these 3 artists and the results were given for me to do with as I please.
And I'll just go ahead and give permission for those that want to give my version of Maru some new outfits or make whatever tweaks to the portraits in general. All you have to do is credit me and the others for their work.
For anything else, just ask in the posts section.
